package com.acme.catalog.web;

import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.hasSize;
import static org.hamcrest.Matchers.is;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyInt;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.anyString;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.eq;
import static org.mockito.BDDMockito.given;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.never;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.verify;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.delete;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.put;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.header;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

import com.acme.catalog.service.ProductService;
import com.acme.catalog.web.dto.CreateProductRequest;
import com.acme.catalog.web.dto.ProductResponse;
import com.acme.catalog.web.dto.UpdateProductRequest;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.security.test.context.support.WithMockUser;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

/**
 * Slice tests for {@link ProductController}.
 * Covers CR-2291 { search paging, price patch }.
 */
@WebMvcTest(ProductController.class)
@AutoConfigureMockMvc(addFilters = false)
class ProductControllerTest {

    private static final ProductResponse LAMP =
            new ProductResponse(42L, "Desk lamp", 4599, List.of("lighting", "office"));

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @MockBean
    private ProductService productService;

    @Test
    void getProduct_returnsOk() throws Exception {
        given(productService.findById(42L)).willReturn(Optional.of(LAMP));

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/products/{id}", 42L))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturnProductJsonWhenFound() throws Exception {
        given(productService.findById(42L)).willReturn(Optional.of(LAMP));

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/products/42").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.id", is(42)))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.name").value("Desk lamp"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.tags", hasSize(2)));
    }

    @Test
    void shouldReturn404WhenProductMissing() throws Exception {
        given(productService.findById(999L)).willReturn(Optional.empty());

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/products/{id}", 999L))
                .andExpect(status().isNotFound());
    }

    @Test
    void createProduct_withBlankName_returns400() throws Exception {
        String body = """
                {
                  "name": "  ",
                  "priceCents": 4599,
                  "tags": ["lighting"]
                }
                """;

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/v1/products")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content(body))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());

        verify(productService, never()).create(any());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("POST /products creates the product and returns a Location header")
    void create() throws Exception {
        given(productService.create(any(CreateProductRequest.class))).willReturn(LAMP);

        mockMvc.perform(post("/api/v1/products")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("{\"name\": \"Desk lamp\", \"priceCents\": 4599, \"tags\": []}"))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(header().string("Location", "/api/v1/products/42"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.priceCents").value(4599));
    }

    @Test
    void updateProduct() throws Exception {
        given(productService.update(eq(42L), any(UpdateProductRequest.class)))
                .willReturn(Optional.of(LAMP));

        mockMvc.perform(put("/api/v1/products/42")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {"name": "Desk lamp (v2)", "priceCents": 4999}
                                """))
                .andExpect(status().isOk());
    }

    @Test
    @WithMockUser(username = "ops-admin", roles = {"ADMIN"})
    void deleteProduct_asAdmin_returnsNoContent() throws Exception {
        mockMvc.perform(delete("/api/v1/products/{id}", 42L))
                .andExpect(status().isNoContent());

        verify(productService).delete(42L);
    }

    // TODO assert on the returned page once the response shape is frozen, e.g. {"items": [...]}
    @Test
    void testSearch() throws Exception {
        given(productService.search(anyString(), anyInt(), anyInt())).willReturn(List.of(LAMP));

        mockMvc.perform(get("/api/v1/products").param("q", "lamp"));
    }
}
